subject.title: iOS app: node requests re-approval on every reconnect (token persistence bug)

question: Is the merged LAN bootstrap-token fix enough to close this repeated iOS node reapproval report, or should this issue wait for current-main real iPhone reconnect proof?
rationale: Source and history prove a related fix landed, but they do not prove the reported app-close/reopen reapproval loop is gone because current iOS still sends dynamic permission/watch declarations and current gateway code treats declaration changes as reapproval-worthy.

options.title: Keep Open For Live iOS Proof
options.body: Leave this issue open until a current-main iPhone on LAN or VPN reconnects several times after one approval without creating a new pending reapproval.

options.title: Close As Covered By Bootstrap Fix
options.body: Close only if a maintainer accepts the LAN QR bootstrap fix as sufficient despite the missing proof for manual setup and dynamic permission-surface reapproval.

options.title: Queue A Repair Immediately
options.body: Start a code repair now, but that risks fixing the wrong path before the current-main iOS behavior is separated from the already-fixed bootstrap-token loss.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Live iOS Proof
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until a current-main iPhone on LAN or VPN reconnects several times after one approval without creating a new pending reapproval.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest overlap across iOS gateway connection behavior and gateway pairing follow-up work.
